result.summary: The page is generally polished, but several horizontally scrollable elements appear clipped and the fixed bottom navigation overlaps the next restaurant card.

issues.description: The category row and “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel are visibly cut off at the right edge, showing partial pills/cards and truncated text such as “Trattoria Piccol…”.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has intentional overflow behavior with clear scroll affordance, consistent right-side padding, and clipping that does not make content look accidentally broken.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation covers the lower portion of the next restaurant card, making its content difficult to view and potentially inaccessible near the bottom of the scroll area.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scroll container so content can scroll fully above the navigation bar, or otherwise prevent the fixed navigation from obscuring cards.
